أرتدع (form VIII)
# أَرْتَدِعُ (ʔartadiʕu) /ʔar.ta.di.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَدَعَ (irtadaʕa)
# أَرْتَدِعَ (ʔartadiʕa) /ʔar.ta.di.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَدَعَ (irtadaʕa)
# أَرْتَدِعْ (ʔartadiʕ) /ʔar.ta.diʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَدَعَ (irtadaʕa)
